sentences.text: In this application also, averments have been made in regard to the service of notice for the purpose of assailing the order dated 19.07.2024 and and in view of the observations of this Court in the order dated 15.05.2024, quoted above, this ground is not available to the applicant.
Further, as per the settled principle of law, the application for discharge would not be maintainable in the proceedings instituted under Section 138 of N. I. Act 7.
For the aforesaid reasons, this Court is not inclined to interfere in the impugned order.
The application is dismissed accordingly.
